en: A sepia-toned postcard image showing a seaside scene with several small boats on the water. Along the shoreline are a number of buildings, including a prominent structure with a tower and a smokestack, likely a bathhouse or seaside resort. The right side of the postcard features some residential-looking structures, all set against a backdrop of trees and rocky terrain. There is a small amount of text printed in the bottom left corner.
